summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Chatter-Free / HEM feature (Phase 4). Backend API fully functional (25/25 tests passed). Frontend calculations accurate and match POC specifications. All core features working: RCTF compensation, radial engagement presets, chatter frequency analysis, gain comparison, and integration with hardness/tool-life/machine-limit cards. Minor UI navigation issues in history reopen.
